description: Long-poll one run until it finalizes or timeout_s elapses (max 25s), returning its current status either way -- for a client with no polling loop of its own.

run_id.description: The run id to wait on.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

timeout_s.description: Max seconds to wait, capped at 25; default 20.

name: host.runs.wait
